card.name: Last digit of interval numbers
card.fires_on: The final digit of a multi-digit number in a dosing interval or numeric series, such as the 2 in 12 hours, the 6 in 6 to 8 hours, or the 2 in 72. It fires in tables and schedules of hours or amounts.

modes.label: Hours in dosing intervals
modes.description: A digit completing the hour count after 'every' in dosing schedules.

modes.label: Numbers in a series
modes.description: A digit completing a number in a list of increasing values or ages.

card.plain: It marks the last digit of a number like 12 or 72 in a dosing interval or numeric list.
